Who Gets Constituent Service?

Rochelle Snyder, Eleanor Neff Powell, Devin Judge-Lord, Justin Grimmer

These plots can be found in the Correspondence/figs folder on dropbox and APSA2020/figs folder on github.

source(here::here("setup.R"))

library(ggplot2); theme_set(theme_bw())
  options(
    ggplot2.continuous.color = "viridis",
    ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
  )
  scale_color_discrete <- function(...)
    scale_color_viridis_d(...)
  scale_fill_discrete <- function(...)
    scale_fill_viridis_d(...)
load(here::here("data/all_contacts.Rdata"))
d <- all_contacts

d %<>% 
    mutate(TYPE = replace_na(TYPE, "NA"),
           constituent = ifelse(TYPE == 1, "Indiv. Constituent Service", "Other")) %>% 
  add_count(icpsr, constituent, agency, year, name = "n_per_year_agency_type") %>% 
  add_count(icpsr, year, name = "n_per_year") %>% 
  mutate(percent_type_to_agency = (n_per_year_agency_type/n_per_year)*100)


d1 <- d %>% 
  filter(year > 2006, year <2018) %>% 
  select(icpsr, year, agency, constituent, n_per_year_agency_type, percent_type_to_agency) %>%
  filter(agency %in% c("VA", #"SSA", 
                       "DHHS_CMS", "DHHS_CDC", "DHHS_HRSA")) %>% 
  distinct()

Number of legislator contacts per agency per year 2007-2017

d1 %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = year, color = constituent, y = n_per_year_agency_type) +
  #geom_line(aes(group= icpsr), alpha = .1) + 
  geom_smooth() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of contacts", color = "") + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ agency, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2007,2017, 2)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

Percent of legislator contacts per agency per year 2007-2017

d1 %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = year, y = percent_type_to_agency, color = constituent) +
  #geom_line(aes(group= icpsr), alpha = .1) + 
  geom_smooth() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Percent of contacts", color = "") + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ agency, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2007,2017, 2)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

Constituent type count:

horizontal bars showing the occurrence of type broken down by agency (so, for example, one bar would be all veterans showing how much of that appears in VA, DOL_VETS, etc.)

load(here::here("data", "dcounts_min.Rdata"))



countplot <- function(countvar, title){
  dcounts_min$var <- countvar
  
dcounts_min %>% 
  group_by(agency) %>% 
  summarize(count = sum(var)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(count > 0) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(y = count, x = agency, label = count) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(hjust = -.02) + 
  coord_flip()+ 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expand_scale(mult =  c(0,.2))) +
    labs(y = paste("Letters on Behalf", title), 
         x = "Agency") + 
  #facet_wrap("agency", scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}

countplot(dcounts_min$per_icpsr_chamber_year_agency_vet, "Veterans")

countplot(dcounts_min$per_icpsr_chamber_year_agency_military, "Military Families, Personal, and Veterans")

countplot(dcounts_min$per_icpsr_chamber_year_agency_lowincome, "Low Income Constituents")

countplot(dcounts_min$per_icpsr_chamber_year_agency_senior, "Seniors")

countplot(dcounts_min$per_icpsr_chamber_year_agency_hardship, "Constituents Experiencing Hardship")

Constituent type share of total per agency

Figure showing the proportion of letters out of total letters within each agency (that we’re using) that are on behalf of each constituent type Basically showing how many of these letters there are and how common they are compared to other letters

dcounts_min %>% 
  #select(-per_icpsr_chamber_year_agency_type) %>%
  group_by(agency) %>% 
  summarise(across(starts_with("per_"), sum)) %>% 
  gather(key = type, value = count, -agency) %>%
  mutate(type = str_remove_all(type, ".*_") %>% str_replace("type", "All") ) %>%
  group_by(agency) %>% 
  mutate(agencycount = sum(count)) %>%
  filter(count >0, agencycount > count) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = agency, y = count, fill = type, label = count) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  #geom_text(position = "dodge", hjust = 0) + 
  coord_flip()+ 
  scale_y_continuous()+#expand = expand_scale(mult =  c(0,.2))) +
    labs(y = "", 
         x = "Agency") + 
  facet_wrap("agency", scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank())
